meta.title: cbct-panoramic-curve-proposal · LRO Front, Worker, Python Compute
meta.subtitle: MLE · system dia · panoramic curve proposals from CBCT scans

views.label: Submit and poll
views.note: Compute, GetOperation and WaitOperation on port 50051. WaitOperation is capped at 10 minutes.

views.label: Claim and compute
views.note: The worker claims one row, keeps the lease alive, then calls the Python sidecar over localhost:50071.

views.label: Inside the worker pod
views.note: The sidecar asks for 8000Mi and may burst to 20Gi, a mid-range ceiling for an MLE compute image.

cards.title: Same spine as every MLE LRO service
items: main.go supplies only serviceName, validateRequest and a whitelist
Queue mechanics and the Operations API come from postgres-lro/lro
The Deployment is contributed by k8s/postgres-lro-patch/lro, not by this directory

cards.title: Worker to sidecar
items: Cold start is slow, so the compute call is retried 15 times at 1s intervals
Only codes.Unavailable is retried; any other error fails the work item immediately
Blob IDs become signed URLs because the Python side holds no storage credentials

cards.title: Resource shape
items: The sidecar requests 8000Mi and may burst to 20Gi against a 5 CPU limit
The Go container stays at 1 CPU and 1024Mi, as in every other family
A last-failure-volume is mounted into the sidecar so a crashed run leaves a trace

cards.title: Operations
items: LRO duration threshold is 210s under opdoc DIA-029; the worker is DIA-030
Older cbctai-panoramic-curve-proposal monitor keys still point at ene-services
